reply_text:
I saved it and replied to Hollis in their DM, saying I'd saved that their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups is Gate 40 from now on.

The fact is stored in the brain under Hollis Mbeki as a preference, sourced to this DM, and it doesn't expire. Before saving I checked for an older dock note and found none, though that search runs on keywords only here, so it could have missed one worded differently.

One thing to check: the save came back marked `visibility: "world"`. The tool says members' saves are private by default, so this may be fine, but it might mean other people's sessions can recall it. Hollis told me this in a DM, and I promised to keep it to our conversations. If you want that promise to hold for certain, the brain's sharing settings should be checked.

My first reply attempt failed because the DM tool wanted a member, not the DM channel ID, so I posted it in the DM thread instead.
